verdict.rationale: Trilegal is an Indian full-service law firm, a professional-services provider rather than a software product, so an official CLI is outside its product category. The evidence (practice pages, an llms.txt file, a web-based DPDPA assessment tool, and 404s on every OpenAPI path) shows no shipped CLI or other developer tooling that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
